tiles.title: Total revenue
tiles.sql: SELECT round(sum(revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM global_sales

tiles.title: Orders
tiles.sql: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM global_sales

tiles.title: Average order value
tiles.sql: SELECT round(avg(revenue), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM global_sales

tiles.title: Monthly revenue
tiles.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) AS month, round(sum(revenue), 2) AS revenue
FROM global_sales
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY month

tiles.title: Revenue by region
tiles.sql:
SELECT region, round(sum(revenue), 2) AS revenue
FROM global_sales
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY revenue DESC

tiles.title: Revenue share by channel
tiles.sql:
SELECT channel, round(sum(revenue), 2) AS revenue
FROM global_sales
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY revenue DESC
